item.title: 【Requests】[REQ VID] - Top Of The Pops 1080i .ts BBC Four Feeds
item.description:
Hi

There are a few pockets of these 1080i feeds around, but does anyone have, is anyone aware of a complete or big archive anywhere?

I've found a few on rutracker from the early 80s which are full episodes. There are a lot from the 70s and 80s on archive but they're hevc and deinterlaced at 25fps.

I'm trying to get as complete an archive as I can but really struggling. I know there have been a few individual performances and the specials on here too but i'm mainly looking for the full weekly episodes with as high quality vid/audio as possible.

Thanks
J
